show.description: Akhila, a blacklisted model, becomes secretary to billionaire Karthik reddy Singhania, who hides his identity to win her love. Their contract romance is plagued by sabotage from jealous rivals and vindictive exes. Just as she's about to marry him, she discovers Karthik reddy orchestrated the ruse to humiliate her, not wed her. When all is lost, she's saved by another billionaire, and her life takes a series of unexpected, life-changing turns.
